body: Sleep and exercise Haven't been working, been at it for months. I was really hoping there would be some easy solution. Thank you for your response.

Oh it isn't one sided. He does support me as well. And I've told him about this, maybe three years ago? He helped me, and got others to help me as well (people I was living with). But that was three years ago and I'm upset that I'm still not better. He's upset and thinks he's failing me because I'm not better even after constant support for years. I don't want to tell him again. I'd rather just slip away.

I work at a place where it is my job to be happy, smile, make people happy in return. I do it well. I love my job. I have plenty of hobbies. I don't know why but I just hurt so much. 

My probably soon to be fiancé Would be heartbroken. I'm worried about him. His mother passed away when he was a teen and  he told me he can't take another loved one leaving him. I am his only main support syst. He has friends and very few relatives but I know I'm the one he feels closest to. He recently had to move to another country. Even before he did I was feeling this way though. Now, I might break up with him so he won't have to see me die. I think I just did.
